What happens to these taps

Every tap saves in this page as you make it — close the tab, come back on the phone, it is still here. When you are done, or partway, hit Export at the top, then Copy all and paste it into the chat, or Download .jsonl and send the file. Nothing leaves the page until you do that.

Lane 1 kills B: 1,000 of 1,017 traded signals carry it only because the engine floors the first with-trend signal of the day. Lane 2 is the recall wound — the engine finds 3 of your 15 held-out S days, and a level plus a direction is all it needs to rebuild the entry and the stop. Lane 3 is the give-back: 53.8% of trades touch 2R and the shipped ladder keeps it on 27.0%, and only you can say how much of the position should still be on at 11:00.
